visual_text: A leaflet is a starting point, not the treatment
The comparison group in a large English trial got the booklet. Four nurse sessions of sleep restriction did better.
Sleep restriction: time in bed matched to time asleep
Kyle, Lancet 2023; Buysse, Arch Intern Med 2011; Edinger, JCSM 2021
alt_text: Comparison card. Left: leaflet sleep hygiene advice about caffeine and alcohol, a dark room and screens. Right: what treats long-term insomnia: stimulus control, sleep restriction and full CBT for insomnia. A leaflet is a starting point, not the treatment.
